# Vendored front-end libraries

All files in `public/vendor/` are copied unmodified from their npm packages. No build step is needed.

| Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | MIT |
| Chart.js | 4.4.4 | MIT |
| Inter (via @fontsource/inter) | 5.1.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Cormorant Garamond (via @fontsource/cormorant-garamond) | 5.1.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | MIT |
| html5-qrcode | 2.3.8 | Apache-2.0 |
